LanguageData.APM_Absorb.label: Recycle Biomass
LanguageData.APM_Absorb.description: Grind up a fresh organic corpse or ingestible material, and slowly process it into chemfuel.
LanguageData.APM_SwitchToPowerPlantMode.label: Power Plant Mode
LanguageData.APM_SwitchToPowerPlantMode.description: Switch to power plant mode, trade mobility and shield to power local power grid.
LanguageData.APM_SunRay.label: Sun Ray
LanguageData.APM_SunRay.description: The gazer blasts a devastating beam from itself, remaining stationary to keep the beam on target. Anything within reach of the beam takes heavy damage.
LanguageData.APM_PulseLongjump.label: mech longjump
LanguageData.APM_PulseLongjump.description: Jump to a distant location using special ultrafast mechanoid muscles.
LanguageData.APM_PulseWave.label: pulse wave
LanguageData.APM_PulseWave.description: Unleash a blinding acoustic pulse that expands out from the mech, stunning and flash-blinding living pawns caught in the wave.
LanguageData.APM_HookPawn.label: Grappling Hook
LanguageData.APM_HookPawn.description: The Terminus launches its grappling hook, either pulling a foe towards it or itself towards a foe depending on the bodysize of the target.
LanguageData.APM_ShieldCharge.label: Shield Charge
LanguageData.APM_ShieldCharge.description: Charge at a pawn, stunning everything hit on the way.
LanguageData.APM_Bladehopp.label: Bladehopp
LanguageData.APM_Bladehopp.description: The mantis lunges forward, executing a brutal slash on a chosen target.
LanguageData.APM_BlindingLaser.label: Blinding Laser
LanguageData.APM_BlindingLaser.description: Fire a laser at target, effectively blinding them for a short time.
LanguageData.APM_Starfall.label: Starfall
LanguageData.APM_Starfall.description: Ravager overcharges its artillery and launches a single heavy shell that splits into three energy blasts while still in flight.
LanguageData.APM_DefenceMatrix.label: Defence Matrix
LanguageData.APM_DefenceMatrix.description: Remotely project a personal defense shield onto a same-faction pawn. The shield stops incoming damage, but also prevents shooting out. The tinker will be focused on projecting the shield.
LanguageData.APM_Ability_SteelDiscipline.label: Steel Discipline
LanguageData.APM_Ability_SteelDiscipline.description: In a radius around the Vassal, its allies gain a speed boost and their mental break chance is reduced if organic. The Vassal's commanding presence inspires those nearby with renewed purpose and fortitude.
LanguageData.APM_Ability_ToxicMist.label: Toxic Mist
LanguageData.APM_Ability_ToxicMist.description: Similar to a tox pack, the haze releases tox gas around itself, enveloping the surrounding area in a toxic cloud.
LanguageData.APM_Shockwave.label: Shockwave
LanguageData.APM_Shockwave.description: An explosive wave that throws enemies within a radius for a certain distance
